purpose: Define the restricted-source, accountable-owner, reconciliation, review, cost-driver, exception, retention, and close-cycle evidence required before Mythical calculates runway, publishes forecasts, activates financial integrations, approves spend, or makes monetization commitments.

restrictedSourceClasses.sourceClass: Accounting ledger and reconciled close reports
Approved contracts, commitments, invoices, and renewals
Revenue, billing, payment, refund, and fee reports
Provider usage, quota, plan, price, tax, credit, and retry reports
Payroll, contractor, tax, and professional-service obligations

baselineEvidenceClasses.evidenceClass: Verified legal entity and accounting perimeter
Reporting currency, fiscal year, tax and accounting basis
Unrestricted and restricted cash at a reconciled cutoff
Committed liabilities, contracts, renewals, and purchase obligations
Trailing recognized and collected revenue with fees and refunds separated
Trailing operating expense by approved cost category
Forward fixed obligations including payroll and contractor commitments
Variable AI, hosting, storage, egress, support, and research costs
Tax, VAT, payment processor, refund, and platform obligations
Active vendor plans, regions, prices, credits, free allowances, minimums, and overages
Usage and accepted-output counts linked to each material variable cost driver
Approved spend limits, exception thresholds, and technical stop controls

requiredExercises.scenario: A missing or stale restricted source prevents close and any runway calculation
Bank-to-ledger difference remains visible and blocks reviewed actuals above the approved threshold
Duplicate invoice or charge is detected before it can enter approved cost totals
Currency, tax, plan, region, credit, free allowance, and price-date mismatch fails closed
Provider retry, failure, abuse, or acceptance-yield deterioration produces a reviewed exception
Restricted actual, bank, invoice, payroll, tax, investor, or customer data cannot enter shared output
Preparer cannot approve the close or suppress a material unresolved exception
Spend request above zero or an unapproved threshold remains blocked without trusted separate approval
Read identity, export, calculation, alert, and future executor can be revoked or killed independently
Protected source references, close evidence, backup, restore, retention, deletion, and replay controls recover accurately

activationGates.gate: D-016 records finance owner, backup, restricted source process, and professional review without authorizing access
Finance owner and backup accept their roles and exception coverage
Close preparer and independent reviewer accept separated roles
Legal entity, reporting currency, fiscal year, tax and accounting perimeter are professionally verified
Restricted source classes, owners, recovery, retention, deletion, export, and access boundaries are approved
Close calendar, cutoff, source freeze, staleness, preparer, reviewer, and exception deadlines are approved
All twelve baseline evidence classes have current opaque source references and independent reconciliation
Chart of accounts, cost centers, vendors, contracts, invoices, payments, and commitments reconcile
All seven A-022 cost drivers have verified usage, price, unit cost, owner, limit, and source date
Provider retries, failures, credits, allowances, abuse ceilings, quotas, alerts, and kill switches are verified
Restricted values cannot enter shared repository, logs, prompts, alerts, drafts, or published outputs
Protected metadata-only close history, audit, backup, restore, retention, deletion, and replay controls pass
Variance, anomaly, duplicate, missing-source, stale-source, and unreconciled-difference thresholds are approved
Spend policy keeps all agent limits at zero until separately approved and technically enforced
All ten exercises pass with independent finance and assurance review
Four consecutive accurate closes are independently reviewed and exceptions reconciled
Runway and scenario formulas, assumptions, sensitivities, staleness, and publication boundary are approved
Any future read integration receives separate least-privilege approval; payment and source writes remain out of scope
